text.card: A red giant 2,756 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 6, give 0.89 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; GALAH spectra give 4,765 K at its surface.
